The river runs low beside the town. Maya shows you two jars: one holds clear water from the wetland, and the other holds cloudy water from the farm. The mayor wants a plan before the next dry season. You remember that heat makes water evaporate and plants release water into the air. A farmer says more trees will use too much water. What evidence would help you decide how to protect the town’s supply?
